text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks after gains, but past price movements do not predict what comes next; I should base each trade on current prospects, not the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","Treating each stock as a separate account makes me focus too much on whether it is above my purchase price. I should assess the whole portfolio and avoid letting reference prices dictate decisions.","My account value fell in some periods despite earlier gains. I should manage risk and diversification consistently rather than assuming recent wins protect me from future losses."]}
